contract_reproduction.contract: Retained-risk cleanup eligibility and immutable historical parent/item
exact_text: PLAN.md §15: ‘a narrowly eligible escalated disposition can satisfy only `FAILED|CANCELLED`, never hide credentials, live authority, shared mutable resources, public exposure, or unknown classification, and never reopens terminal Work or its terminal CleanupItem.’
docs/state-transition-manifests.md §13: ‘It is terminal-equivalent only for `FAILED` or `CANCELLED` work when policy explicitly lists that cleanup class as retainable.’
docs/state-transition-manifests.md §13: ‘It is never terminal-equivalent for `DONE`, secrets/credentials, live lease/grant, shared mutable workspace, public exposure, or an unclassified item.’
PLAN.md §13: ‘Terminal Work is immutable. When retained risk resurfaces, the parent Work and terminal CleanupItem never reopen.’
contract_reproduction.audit_result: pass; eligibility is narrow, unsafe resource classes cannot be waived, DONE requires actual cleanup, and C11 leaves the historical parent and CleanupItem unchanged.

contract_reproduction.contract: Sole re-authorization path and child/effect containment
exact_text: docs/state-transition-manifests.md RO14: `REVOKED -> IN_PROGRESS` requires ‘new independent purpose-bound authorization, child quiescent, old effects settled, fresh attempt budget; no work/admission/effect before this row commits’.
PLAN.md §13: ‘RO14 is the sole reauthorization row and no work may occur before it commits.’
docs/state-transition-manifests.md RO12: revocation requires the ‘child quiescence receipt and terminal Effect dispositions’ to commit atomically, with ‘no hidden activity behind BLOCKED’.
contract_reproduction.audit_result: pass; revoked work cannot restart by signal replay, child reset, stale authority, or an alternate row. Re-entry preserves the generation/history and requires fresh joint authority and settled prior activity.

exact_text: docs/state-transition-manifests.md RO08: `IN_PROGRESS -> VERIFYING` requires ‘child terminal-clean; every child effect settled; every CleanupItem terminal-clean; claimed resource release/removal receipts already committed’.

docs/state-transition-manifests.md RO09: `VERIFYING -> CLOSED` requires the protected closure oracle, a signed `RemediationClosureReceipt` binding the generation and receipt set, and ‘no authority/resource ownership remains’.
docs/state-transition-manifests.md §13.1: ‘Only RO09 is terminal.’

docs/state-transition-manifests.md §13.1: ‘Admission may remove a bound resource-key block only in the RO09 transaction and only when `status=CLOSED` and the exact `RemediationClosureReceipt` verifies. No human waiver, CleanupEscalationDisposition, child terminal, or accepted risk alone unblocks it.’
PLAN.md §15: ‘every bound resource remains blocked until the obligation is `CLOSED` with its verified closure receipt.’
contract_reproduction.audit_result: pass; child completion alone cannot close or unblock. Closure consumes already committed child/effect/cleanup/resource receipts, uses an independent verifier, and atomically controls the block removal.
